info.title: Orkestr API
info.description: Autonomous enterprise operations & proposal intelligence. n8n orchestrates; this API is the source of truth.

get.description: The signed-in user's own sign-in attempts, including failures against their address.
All sign-in attempts for the admin's organisation (plus attempts for unknown addresses).

post.description: Clear a lockout before it expires. Recorded in the audit chain.
Idempotent: the email Message-ID is the idempotency key; content-level dedup catches resends.
UI entry point: submits a request through n8n Workflow A exactly like an inbound email.
Execute one policy-approved internal action (Jira task, Slack alert) — used by Workflow B.
A human confirms a case held for manipulation is safe to continue; re-runs the pipeline.

get.description: Bounding boxes of a requirement on its PDF page, for the source viewer overlay.
Re-verify identity, role and scope of the decision before anything executes.

post.description: n8n reports steps that do not call a business endpoint (validation, waits, notifications, completion).
Called by the n8n error workflow (Z). Creates a dead letter and marks the run failed.
Simulator-only chaos control used by case study 3 (retry, recovery, dead-lettering).
